subject: Re: Kickoff: GON - auditable black-box optimization for trust-theory
body:
Ximena,

Staffing through the window and into the hardening phase after it:

- Gustavo 50% (simulation repro, done via `python -m gon.simulation` configs - already green as of last week)
- Umar 30% (theory review of the lattice constraint formulation)
- Yara 40% (conditional GON prototype)
- Chiara 50% (packaging + API)

For the hardening phase I have Linnea Yamada committed at 60% to this project for June 2026 - she is the only one of the five with production lattice-model experience, so please treat that allocation as load-bearing. If June slips, the productionization slips with it.

Compute is a non-issue: everything fits on a handful of CPUs plus 4 GPUs for the DNN baselines we compare against. No cluster reservations needed.

Bruno
